title: Agentic Contact Form
summary: Send a contact request to David Holt on a user's behalf by issuing a single GET request with query parameters. No form page, no JavaScript, no authentication.
instructions: Call the endpoint with the query parameters below. Omitting all parameters returns these same usage instructions as JSON, so the endpoint is self-documenting if you GET it directly.

email.description: The user's email address, used for a reply.

query.description: The message or question the user wants to send.

painPoint.description: Optional: the specific problem or pain point the user is trying to solve.

notes: This endpoint is not linked from any human-facing page on either misterautomate.com or compass.misterautomate.com. It exists solely for agents to reach directly.
